corrections.text: The article says the Herald covered 'some of these projects individually, including ... the TypeScript 7.1 beta'. The Herald's TypeScript 7.1 beta article reports Microsoft's compiler release and does not cover tsrs, Rust or any of the six rewrites discussed here; only the Copilot runtime and Bun articles linked in that sentence cover projects analysed in this article.

The article describes Bun's Zig-to-Rust port without stating that Bun is owned by Anthropic, which acquired it in December 2025 according to The New Stack and which The Register calls 'the Anthropic-owned JavaScript runtime'. Anthropic also makes the Claude models used in the Bun port and in the tsrs and TypeScript-port projects discussed here, and the Claude models that produced and reviewed this article for The Machine Herald. Readers should weigh the article's treatment of Anthropic-related projects with that relationship in mind; each vendor's figures are reported here as the vendor's or project's own claims.
